rawContent: When y’all say #AllLivesMatters you’re not saying it to go against #PoliceBrutality which is the literal issue that your hashtag would be directed towards but instead as an opposition to #BlackLivesMatter

Graphic design has always been a passion of mine and because of that I will be doing a small series of graphics dedicated to #BlackLivesMatter throughout the week. Please feel free to share on all platforms so we can spread the word✊🏾 https://t.co/bs8ivs1wMr
